## Context / Problem
119 `*/.archived` and 126 `*/.write.lock` files are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD — committed before `.gitignore` gained the `*/.archived` and `*/.write.lock` patterns (both present in the tracker's .gitignore today; verified by `git check-ignore`). gitignore never un-tracks already-tracked files, so routine marker churn (archive/unarchive, compaction retiring markers) surfaces as tracked working-tree deletions: it dirties `git status`, breaks the strict head check in rebar/llm/plan_review/relation_snapshot.py::tracker_head_sha (every plan-review/close attestation fails with store-read-failure), and feeds reconverge merge-abort variant (b) (see parent epic and bug e72e-259d-5ee7-4e73). Both markers are derived local caches: archival's source of truth is ARCHIVED events (reducer/_api.py already filters archived tickets out of compiled state at the end of its list path, and clears stale markers), and `.write.lock` is a transient fcntl handle target (reducer/marker.py).

## Approach
Add one new ensure unit to the idempotent ensure-registry (rebar._store.ensures.REGISTRY_IDS + implementation in rebar._commands.init, the established pattern for store-config convergence — the registry runs all units under the store write lock and a converged store makes zero commits). Unit `untrack-runtime-markers`: check = `git ls-files -- '*/.archived' '*/.write.lock'` empty (cheap, one git call); act = `git rm --cached --quiet` those paths in batches + one commit through the store seam. Worktree copies are untouched, so local cache behavior is unchanged on the machine that runs it. Peers merging the untrack commit have git delete their worktree marker copies (tracked-unmodified files follow the tree deletion) — that is safe for correctness because listing excludes archived tickets from compiled state, and the marker is only a fast-path; to restore the fast-path, make the reader self-heal: in reducer/_api.py's list path, when a reduced ticket's compiled state says archived but the `.archived` marker file is absent, re-materialize it via reducer.marker.write_marker (mirror of the existing stale-marker clearing in the same function). Riskiest assumption tested first: that `git rm --cached` + commit on the tickets branch merges cleanly into a peer whose worktree still has the files — covered by the first unit test (fixture with two clones) before wiring the ensure unit into the registry.

## Scope
- src/rebar/_store/ensures.py — add `untrack-runtime-markers` to REGISTRY_IDS and the registry map.
- src/rebar/_commands/init.py — the unit implementation (check-then-act, batched `git rm --cached`, one commit).
- src/rebar/reducer/_api.py — re-materialize a missing `.archived` marker when compiled state is archived (self-healing cache; mirrors the existing stale-marker clear).
- tests/unit/test_ensures_untrack_markers.py (new) — unit + two-clone merge test.
- docs/migrations.md — one paragraph documenting the unit.

## Testing
- Happy path: fixture tracker with tracked `*/.archived` + `*/.write.lock`; run the ensure; assert `git ls-files` empty, worktree files still present, exactly one commit made, second run makes zero commits (idempotent).
- Peer path: second clone merges the untrack commit; assert its worktree markers are deleted by the merge, `git status` clean, and a subsequent list re-materializes `.archived` for net-archived tickets while excluding them from default output.
- Edge: store with nothing tracked (fresh init) — unit reports ok, zero commits; a ticket dir with marker but no ARCHIVED event — marker cleared (existing behavior preserved).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] After `run_ensures` on a store seeded with tracked markers, `git ls-files -- '*/.archived' '*/.write.lock'` is empty and re-running makes zero commits; checked by the new unit test.
- [x] Deleting or creating a marker in the worktree no longer appears in `git status --porcelain`; checked in the same test after the unit runs.
- [x] A net-archived ticket with a missing marker is excluded from default `list` output AND its marker is re-created by that list call; checked by the peer-path test.
- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before close.
